question: The six-digit number N = 4a6b9c is divisible by 99, then the maximum sum of the digits of N is:
solution:
**Given:**

 t

4a6b9c is a six-digit number divisible by 99.

**Concept used:**

Divisibility law of 11 : If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is multiple of 11 or 0, then the number is divisible by 11.

Divisibility law of 9 : A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digit is also divisible by 9

**Calculations:**

The six-digit number 4a6b9c is divisible by 99. So, we can say number is also divisible by 9 and 11.

To check the divisibility with 9,

⇒ 4 + a + 6 + b + 9 + c = 19 + a + b + c (equal to multiple of 9)

To check the divisibility with 11,

⇒ 19 - (a + b + c) (equal to multiple of 11)

Now put value of (19 + a + b + c) from the option one by one,

Option (1) 18 

⇒ 18 = 19 + a + b + c

⇒ a + b + c = -1 (Not possible)

Option (2) 36

⇒ 36 = 19 + a + b + c

⇒ a + b + c = 17 

⇒ 19 - 17 = 2 (Not divisible by 11)

Option (3) 45

⇒ 45 = 19 + a + b + c

⇒ a + b + c = 26

⇒ 19 - 26 = -7 (Not divisible by 11)

Option (3) 27

⇒ 27 = 19 + a + b + c

⇒ a + b + c = 8

⇒ 19 - 8 = 11 ( Divisible by 11)

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**
